job.question: One RFP for investment manager services, issued by an education foundation, limits proposals to five single-spaced typewritten pages. How many copies must be submitted and by what deadline?
job.expected_facts: Six copies, no later than 5 PM on July 1, 2016 (Broward Education Foundation).
job.acceptance: Require six copies, July 1, 2016, 5 p.m.; issuer/addressee optional. No timezone is stated, so do not require one.

reviews.reason: This is a 2024 investment consulting RFP issued by a New York City retirement system, not the education foundation’s investment manager RFP. It specifies email submission and a July 12, 2024 deadline, with no five-page limit or six-copy requirement.
quotes: This Request for Proposals (“RFP”) is issued by the NYC Board of Education Retirement System (“BERS” or the “Agency”).
REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR INVESTMENT CONSULTING SERVICES RFP # 2024-003
Proposals will be received via email to: BERSProcurement@bers.nyc.gov Until: 5:00 PM On: July 12, 2024
Although there is no specific limit on the number of pages that applications may contain, applicants are encouraged to be as concise and succinct as possible.
